# Restic Tray

> Pure-Rust Windows system tray app for client-side encrypted periodic backups to Cloudflare R2 with Restic and a built-in 22-tool MCP server.
> Cloudflare R2 と Restic を用いてクライアント側暗号化バックアップを定期実行する、22 ツール MCP サーバー内蔵の純 Rust 製 Windows タスクトレイ常駐アプリ。

## Key Facts

- **Product Name**: Restic Tray (`restic-tray`)
- **Version**: 1.0.0 (bundles official `restic.exe` v0.20.0, SHA-256 verified)
- **License & Price**: MIT License, free ($0, open source)
- **Supported OS**: Windows 10 / Windows 11 / Windows Server 2016 or later (x64, TLS 1.2+)
- **Storage Backend**: Cloudflare R2 (`s3:https://<accountId>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/<bucket>[/<prefix>]`, zero egress fees)
- **Encryption**: Client-side AES-256-CTR + Poly1305-AES with `scrypt` key derivation via standard restic repository format (recoverable anytime with standalone `restic` CLI, no app lock-in)
- **Secret Storage**: Windows DPAPI (`CryptProtectData` + secondary entropy + `Zeroize`) in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\io.github.nayuengin.restic-tray\config\credentials.dat`; secrets are never written to `config.json` or passed as CLI arguments
- **Built-in MCP Server**: `restic-tray.exe --mcp` exposes 22 tools over stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 via a local Windows Named Pipe (`reject_remote_clients(true)` + 256-bit mutual token) with headless fallback; destructive operations (`forget_prune`, `delete_r2_bucket`, `takeover_project`) are opt-in (`false` by default) and default to `dryRun: true`
- **Desktop UI Language**: Currently Japanese only (website and documentation are bilingual EN / JA)
- **Telemetry & Network**: Zero telemetry, no author-operated servers, no built-in update checker
- **Affiliation**: Independent unofficial open-source project; not affiliated with restic or Cloudflare
- **Download**: https://github.com/nayuengin/restic-tray/releases/latest

## Documentation (English)

- [Home (English)](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/): Product overview, specifications, comparison with restic CLI, v1.0.0 download links, and FAQ.
- [Overview](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/): Documentation overview and guide index.
- [Installation & Verification](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/installation.html): Download bundles, SHA-256, attestations, and auto-start.
- [Initial Setup & Cloudflare R2](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/setup.html): Create an R2 bucket, least-privilege token, and repository.
- [Basic Usage](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/usage.html): Folders, smart excludes, schedules, verification, and history.
- [MCP Integration](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/mcp.html): Connect AI coding agents and explore all 22 MCP tools.
- [Backup & Restore](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/backup-restore.html): Dry-run, GUI/CLI restore, disaster recovery without the app.
- [Troubleshooting](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/troubleshooting.html): SmartScreen, DPAPI, R2 permissions, locks, and excludes.
- [FAQ & Support Policy](https://nayuengin.github.io/restic-tray/docs/faq.html): Common questions, scope, privacy, and disclaimers.
